metadata.mode: READ-ONLY / NO IMPLEMENTATION / NO UI CHANGE
metadata.objective: Identify what Evidence truly helps Human make Semantic Judgment

executive_summary.finding: DICE has sufficient Evidence FACTS but lacks Evidence RELATIONS. Human reconstructs relations from page image every time.
executive_summary.key_evidence: P722 B1 (no Cue, fields+image) = 100% accuracy, 1.7s; B2 (with Cue) = 93%, 5.9s — Cue added cognitive load without decision value
executive_summary.gap_type: RELATION GAP — not Observation Gap, not Evidence Gap, not Distillation Gap
executive_summary.recommendation: Organize existing Evidence into RELATIONS, not new Observations

p722_results.key_finding: B2 (with Cue) is 3.5x SLOWER than B1 (no Cue), with no accuracy improvement

error_cases.missing: Sentence boundary detection (no Cue in A)

error_pattern: All B2 errors occurred on NON-TLD pages — Human had Cue but Cue lacked structural relations

NUMERIC_PAIR.interpretation: Two numeric values in same table row, different columns

SENTENCE_BOUNDARY.evidence: text_a ends period, text_b starts capital
SENTENCE_BOUNDARY.interpretation: text_a ends sentence, text_b starts new sentence
SENTENCE_BOUNDARY.judgment: Separate sentences → KEEP_SEPARATE (or MERGE if same paragraph)
SENTENCE_BOUNDARY.gap: Missing paragraph membership — caused Reviewer A/B disagreement

TABLE_HEADER.interpretation: Two column headers in same table

MIXED.interpretation: Parameter count + model name in different columns

COLUMN_HEADER_IDENTIFICATION.impact: Human must infer column meaning from image

CONTENT_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION.impact: Human must infer content type from text

CAPTION_BOUNDARY.impact: Human must infer caption scope from image

HEADER_HIERARCHY.impact: Human must infer header relationship from image

CROSS_INSTANCE_PATTERN.impact: Human reconstructs alignment patterns from image

COUNTEREVIDENCE.impact: No evidence that might contradict primary interpretation

compression_vs_distillation.l5_5_compression: A: 15 fields → B1: 8 fields = removed style_sig, doc_id, page_number. IS compression, NOT distillation.
compression_vs_distillation.l5_10_cue: B2 adds 4-7 Cues. IS a form of distillation (transforms raw evidence to text), but INCOMPLETE: Cues are binary/text patterns, not structural relations; duplicate field info; dont provide what Human needs.
compression_vs_distillation.p722_proof: B2 (5.9s) is 3.5x slower than B1 (1.7s) with no accuracy improvement → Cue added cognitive load without decision value
true_distillation_would_be: STRUCTURAL_SUMMARY: "A and B are in row 3, columns top-1 error and top-5 error"
CONTEXT_RELATION: "A ends sentence S1 in paragraph P1; B starts sentence S2 in P1"
CAPTION_CONTEXT: "A is caption label FIG. 9:; B is caption body"
BOUNDARY_INDICATOR: "A and B are at a sentence boundary within same paragraph"

gap_classification.description: DICE has sufficient Evidence FACTS but lacks Evidence RELATIONS between items
gap_classification.not_observation_gap: P1-P6 + TLD observe enough raw facts
gap_classification.not_evidence_gap: Evidence exists, just not organized into relations
gap_classification.not_distillation_gap: Cue is a form of distillation, but incomplete (provides facts not relations)
gap_classification.not_presentation_gap: UI shows evidence but does not organize it
gap_classification.not_human_validation_gap: Validation is about signal, not evidence
what_is_missing: Evidence RELATIONS between items (A in column X, B in column Y)
CONTEXT RELATIONS (A and B in paragraph P / caption C / table T)
CROSS-INSTANCE patterns (A aligns with [X,Y,Z], B aligns with [W,V])

anti_overdesign.conclusion: NO NEW MODULE — gap is Evidence Organization, not Evidence Observation

recommended_minimal_change.change: Organize existing Evidence into RELATIONS, not new Observations
examples: "A and B are in row 3 of Table 2, columns top-1 error and top-5 error"
"A ends sentence S1 in paragraph P1; B starts sentence S2 in P1"
"A is caption label FIG. 9:; B is caption body"
recommended_minimal_change.roi: HIGH — reduces Human reconstruction work, enables true Distillation

confidence.cue_increases_cognitive_load: HIGH — B2 3.5x slower, no accuracy gain
confidence.relation_gap_is_main_issue: MEDIUM-HIGH — based on error cases + rationale analysis
confidence.no_new_observation_needed: MEDIUM — based on existing evidence coverage

limitations: 4 documents (3 tech + 1 medical), limited document diversity
TLD coverage 41%, non-TLD page analysis based on limited sample
Reviewer rationales are post-hoc explanations, may not reflect real-time judgment
No interaction trace (eye tracking, clicks), cannot directly verify what Human viewed
